Title: Coloring molecules for plasma protein binding prediction
Description: Predicts the fraction of a compound bound to plasma proteins, which governs how much drug circulates free and available to act. The endpoint was assembled from sources covering 4,119 drugs and modelled with a message-passing graph neural network, coupled with integrated gradients so that atoms contributing most to the prediction can be highlighted. Combining measurements from several collections introduces assay heterogeneity, and the attribution explains the network's reasoning without validating the underlying value.
Interpretation: Predicted fraction of compound bound to plasma proteins, from 0 to 1.
